text.en:
Any provisions of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, all amounts collected from time
to time by the Bohol and Cagayan Filipino Colonies established under Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred
and fifty-four shall revert to the unappropriated general fund in the Philippine Treasury, and shall not be made
available for expenditure except by subsequent legislative enactment.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 9, 1936.
